# peakhour_rp_cdn_cache (Resource)

Manages RP CDN cache configuration for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_rp_cdn_cache" "example" {
  domain        = "example.com"
  cache_enabled = true
  edge_ttl_sec  = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `browser_ttl_sec` (Number) Browser TTL in seconds. Set to null to clear.
- `cache_enabled` (Boolean) Enable edge caching. Set to null to clear.
- `cache_ignore_request_cache_control` (Boolean) Ignore request Cache-Control headers. Set to null to clear.
- `cache_implicit_ttl` (Number) Implicit cache TTL. Set to null to clear.
- `cache_store_require_cache_control` (Boolean) Only store when Cache-Control allows it. Set to null to clear.
- `cache_strip_cookies` (Boolean) Strip Cookie header before caching. Set to null to clear.
- `cache_strip_set_cookies` (Boolean) Strip Set-Cookie header before caching. Set to null to clear.
- `cache_tag_header` (String) Header name containing cache tags. Set to null to clear.
- `cache_tag_header_separator` (String) Cache tag header separator (spec enum: "," or " "). Set to null to clear.
- `cache_vary_ua_mode` (String) Vary User-Agent mode (spec enum: none, device-type). Set to null to clear.
- `cdn_ignore_invalidate` (Boolean) Ignore invalidate headers. Set to null to clear.
- `cdn_ignore_vary_user_agent` (Boolean) Ignore Vary: User-Agent. Set to null to clear.
- `cdn_query_mode` (String) Cache query mode (spec enum: full, none, strip). Set to null to clear.
- `cdn_remove_query_args` (List of String) Query args to remove before caching. Set to null to clear.
- `cdn_serve_stale` (Boolean) Serve stale content where possible. Set to null to clear.
- `cdn_skip_cookie` (String) Cookie name/pattern that disables caching when present. Set to null to clear.
- `edge_ttl_sec` (Number) Edge TTL in seconds. Set to null to clear.
- `soft_purge` (Boolean) Enable soft purge. Set to null to clear.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) RP CDN cache config identifier (domain/rp_cdn_cache).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_rp_cdn_cache.example example.com
```
